links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified vascular surgery discharge summaries
links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level and Flesch Reading Ease Score) of discharge summaries
links.effect: 39.6% reduction in Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level and 106.37% increase in Ease Score; mean PEMAT-P understandability 77.71, actionability 52.12; accuracy mean 5.21 (6-point scale), completeness mean 2.61 (3-point scale)
links.tradeoff: 10.8% of summaries had omissions and 7.5% had hallucinations, with corrections made in some cases; actionability was only moderate (52.12).
links.quote: AI-generated summaries demonstrated significant improvements in readability, with a 39.6% reduction in Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level and a 106.37% increase in Ease Score.

design_hint: reading-level constraint on LLM-generated discharge summaries
